An Act relative to labor relations policies for committee for 
public counsel services employees.
Be it enacted by the People, and by their authority;
SECTION 1: Section 1 of chapter 150E of the General 
Laws, as appearing in the 2022 Official Edition, is hereby 
amended by adding to the end of the seventh paragraph, 
titled “Employer” or “public employer”, the following 
sentence: “In the case of employees of the committee 
for public counsel services, employer shall mean the 
committee for public counsel services or its designee.”
SECTION 2. Section 7 of said chapter 150E of the General 
Laws, as so appearing, is hereby amended by striking the 
word “or” before the phrase “the state lottery commission” 
in line 16 and adding the following words after that phrase: 
“or the committee for public counsel services.”
SECTION 3. Said section 7 of said chapter 150E of the 
General Laws, as so appearing, is hereby amended by 
striking the word “and” before the words “the state lottery 
commission” appearing in line 34 and inserting after the 
word “commission” in line 35 the following words: “and 
committee for public counsel services.”
